satellites.title: Thunder in the Trigrams
satellites.evidence: The 說卦 commentary associates 震 with thunder. The association is a feature of the symbolic system.
satellites.caveat: A correspondence internal to a historical system; not a statement about natural science.

satellites.title: Thunder Sets Things Moving
satellites.evidence: The Shuogua gives each trigram its work: 雷以動之，風以散之，雨以潤之，日以烜之，艮以止之 — thunder moves things, wind scatters them, rain moistens, the sun dries, Gen stops them.
